name: Awesome Responsive Photo Gallery – Image & Video Lightbox Gallery
author: Realwebcare

sections.description:
Does the default WordPress gallery feel a bit too basic for your website?

By default, when visitors click on a gallery photo, it takes them to a completely new page. This breaks the browsing flow, hurts user experience, and makes your site feel slow.

Awesome Responsive Photo Gallery fixes this exact problem. It automatically upgrades your standard WordPress galleries into a beautiful popup lightbox.

No complex setup is needed. Just install the plugin, and your visitors can view photos and videos in a clean, interactive popup without leaving the page.

FREE VERSION DEMO | PRO VERSION DEMO | EXPLORE PRO | CONTACT US

Watch Video Walkthrough

How Does It Help You?

  • Automatic Upgrade: The plugin replaces the default gallery behavior with a modern lightbox instantly after activation.
  • Keep Visitors on Your Page: Users can click through your images in a popup slider instead of loading new pages.
  • Professional Look: Give your website a premium feel with smooth animations and a polished design.

🚀 Key Features

  • 3 Unique Lightbox Styles: Choose between Awesome Gallery, LightCase, or Jet Gallery scripts to match your theme.
  • Video Support: Easily add YouTube, Vimeo, and HTML5 videos inside your gallery.
  • Mobile Friendly: 100% responsive design with swipe navigation for phone and tablet users.
  • Social Sharing: Visitors can share your photos directly to Facebook, X (Twitter), Pinterest, and LinkedIn.
  • Multiple Galleries: Add as many galleries as you want on a single page using unique Gallery IDs.
  • Editor Friendly: Works perfectly with both the Classic Editor and the Block Editor (Gutenberg).

🎉 What is New in Version 1.2.2?

We have listened to your feedback and added some highly requested features in this update:

  • Customize font sizes for thumbnail titles and captions.
  • Added new image hover effects (Shrink Rotate, Left to Right Half, Caption Fade in Middle).
  • Control the spacing between thumbnails inside the lightbox.
  • Toggle Font Awesome icons on or off to speed up page loading.
  • New database cleanup option to remove plugin data when uninstalled.
  • Overall code optimization for a faster backend and frontend experience.

Usage

Creating a gallery is very easy. Just follow these steps:

  1. Go to Pages > Add New (or edit an existing page).
  2. Click the Add Media button.
  3. Click on Create Gallery on the left side and upload your photos.
  4. Click the Create a New Gallery button at the bottom right.
  5. (Optional) Add Titles, Alt Text, Descriptions, or Video URLs for your images on the right side.
  6. Click Insert Gallery.
  7. Now, add a unique ID to your gallery shortcode. For example: [gallery id="1" ids="10,11,12"].
  8. Save or publish your page. Click View Page to see your new lightbox gallery!

Need to add another gallery on the same page? Just use a different ID like id="2".
You can find more detailed instructions on the Help Page inside the plugin menu.

sections.installation:
You can install this plugin automatically from your WordPress dashboard or upload it manually.

Automatic Installation (Recommended):

  1. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for Awesome Responsive Photo Gallery Realwebcare.
  4. Click Install Now and then click Activate.

Manual Installation:

  1. Download the plugin zip file to your computer.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Click the Upload Plugin button at the top.
  4. Choose the zip file you downloaded and click Install Now.
  5. Activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support videos?

Yes! You can add YouTube, Vimeo, and HTML5 video links. Just paste the video URL in the “Video URL” field under attachment details when creating your gallery.

Can I use more than one gallery on the same page?

Yes, you can add unlimited galleries on a single page. Just make sure to give each gallery a unique ID (like id=”1″, id=”2″, etc.) in the shortcode.

Will this slow down my website?

Not at all. The plugin is built with clean code and performance in mind. You can even turn off Font Awesome icons from the global settings if you do not need them, saving extra loading time.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Yes, all the lightbox scripts included in this plugin are fully responsive and support touch/swipe gestures for mobile devices.

Where can I get help if something goes wrong?

If you face any issues, first check the Help page inside your WordPress admin menu. If you still need help, feel free to visit our Plugin Support Page. We are always ready to help!

1.2.2 (27 July, 2026)

  • Added: Thumbnail title and caption font size option.
  • Added: Additional thumbnail hover image effect called Shrink Rotate.
  • Added: Two additional thumbnail hover overlay effects called Left to Right Half and Caption Fade in Middle.
  • Added: Spacing Between Each Thumbnails inside the lightbox (for Awesome Gallery).
  • Added: Additional Spacing Between Each Thumbnails effect called Scroll Left (for LightCase Gallery).
  • Added: Option to decide whether to show Font Awesome icon or not.
  • Added: Option to clear database on delete.
  • Changed: Optimized plugin performance and code structure.
  • Fixed: Resolved various JavaScript and CSS bugs for smoother frontend rendering.

1.2.1 (7 March, 2025)

  • Fixed: An issue where non-admin users were unable to load the WordPress admin panel due to plugin interference.

1.2 (12 January, 2025)

  • Major update with full Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) implementation.
  • Enhanced security with proper sanitization, validation, escaping, and nonce verification.
  • Modernized admin interface with modal-based messages.
  • Introduced a dedicated help page for plugin features and usage.
  • Improved Classic and Block Editor integration for dynamic Gallery ID.
  • Fixed minor JavaScript and CSS issues.
  • Updated option name to avoid conflicts with other plugins.
  • Organized internal CSS into a custom CSS file.
  • Replaced Google Plus share with LinkedIn share.

1.0.5 (19 May, 2018)

  • Fixed some small bugs.
  • Included Gallery ID button in post editor text mode.

1.0.4 (20 April, 2018)

  • Included thumbnail title and caption with hover effect.
  • Added more gallery options.

1.0.3 (14 April, 2018)

  • Included 3 different gallery scripts.
  • Added more gallery options.
  • Added unlimited gallery support by gallery ID.

1.0.2 (6 April, 2018)

  • Added Thumbnail Border and Shadow Support.

  • Added YouTube and Vimeo Support.

1.0 (8 March, 2018)
